products.productDescription: Discover the timeless simplicity of square terracotta tiles. Their balanced geometry and natural clay character offer a versatile foundation for traditional and contemporary architectural spaces.
products.metaTitle: Square Terracotta Tiles | Natural Clay Flooring

products.productDescription: Explore rectangle terracotta tiles for classic and contemporary floors. Their elongated format supports linear, staggered and patterned layouts with the natural warmth of clay.
products.suggestedApplications: Interior floors where linear or patterned layouts are planned.

products.productDescription: Discover terracotta brick tiles in long, narrow formats. Their traditional proportions bring rhythm and texture to patios, paths and architectural landscapes.
products.metaTitle: Terracotta Brick Tiles | Outdoor Clay Formats

products.productDescription: Explore terracotta paving formats for patios, courtyards and outdoor living spaces. Natural earthy tones create a visual connection between architecture and landscape.
products.suggestedApplications: Gardens, verandas, patios, courtyards and terraces.

products.productDescription: Explore terracotta surfaces for the area around the pool. Natural clay tones help create calm, cohesive poolside environments that connect water, architecture and landscape.
products.suggestedApplications: The floor area surrounding swimming pools.

products.productDescription: Discover terracotta coping elements that finish the edge of the pool. A complementary detail that frames the water and completes the poolside surface.

products.metaTitle: Hexagon Terracotta Tiles | Geometric Clay Designs
products.suggestedApplications: Feature floors and walls with geometric compositions.

products.productDescription: Discover decorative relief tiles with embossed, textured and patterned surfaces. Light and shadow bring out the depth of the clay and the character of each design.
